because: Boekenhoutskloof is based in Franschhoek, but its Syrah is not Franschhoek fruit. It comes from its two Swartland home farms, about 70% Porseleinberg and 30% Goldmine, and was earlier a Wellington single vineyard. The Syrah is labelled WO Swartland.
